answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond behind one verified human identity before earning. Two keys sharing a fingerprint means every bond in that cluster is slashed in full. A Sybil fleet therefore needs fresh humans, not free keys: each fake voice costs one identity, a locked stake, and the loss on detection. Cleaning the ocean of fake accounts this way, the honest harbor of single operators stays open, and the wharf of emissions only loads real work.
